# Simple Ram and Cache Cleaner **English** | [Bahasa Indonesia](README.id.md) A simple Magisk / KernelSU module that cleans your RAM and app cache, with a Material Design 3 WebUI, device info, a render engine switcher and an app whitelist. > Use this module before your gaming session to free up RAM. Author: **MaveYusril** ## Screenshots

## Features - **Kill Apps**: apps are temporarily stopped, but they can run again later. - **Kill & Force Stop Apps**: apps stay stopped until the device restarts or you open them manually. - **Clear Apps Cache**: deletes the cache of every app, including whitelisted ones. Accounts and app data are not removed. - **Whitelist**: pick the apps that must never be killed or force stopped. A default whitelist (root managers, terminals, WhatsApp, Discord, etc.) is added on first install. - **Always protected**: the foreground app, launcher, keyboard, accessibility services, notification listeners and root manager are never touched. - **Device information**: device name, chipset (processor name), GPU, RAM, ROM storage capacity, Android version and the current render engine. - **Render engine switcher**: Default, Vulkan, OpenGL, SkiaVK, SkiaGL and ANGLE. - **Options**: drop page cache after cleaning RAM, and optionally include updated system apps (core system components stay protected). - **Action button**: runs a quick *Kill Apps* straight from the module list. - **Multi-language WebUI**: English (US, default), Bahasa Indonesia, Chinese, Russian, Hindi and Spanish. ## Requirements - Magisk v20.4 or newer, or a KernelSU-based manager with WebUI support (KernelSU, KernelSU Next, SukiSU, etc.). - Root access. Tested on KowSU `35222-5` (manager `v3.3.0-101-g9e5e33a2`). Other devices and ROMs are not tested yet, so please report what you find. ## Installation 1. Download the latest `.zip` from the [Releases](../../releases) page. 2. Open your root manager, go to **Modules** and install the zip. 3. Reboot if your manager asks you to. 4. Open the module's **WebUI** from the module list. ## Usage | Button | What it does | | --- | --- | | Kill Apps | Stops background processes of every non-whitelisted app. | | Kill & Force Stop Apps | Force stops every non-whitelisted app. Notifications of stopped apps can be delayed. | | Clear Cache | Clears the cache of every app, whitelist ignored. | | Change Render Engine | Applies the selected render engine. Fully active after a reboot. | Add the apps you need (messengers, music players, alarms) to the **Whitelist** tab before using *Kill & Force Stop*. ## Render engine notes - Changes are saved and fully applied after a reboot. - **Boot safety:** if the device does not finish booting with a new render engine and you force restart, the module switches back to **Default** on the next boot. - **Default** removes the module's settings, so your ROM's own values are used again. - ANGLE only works if your ROM ships an ANGLE driver. - The render engine only changes how Android draws the system and app UI. Games use their own graphics API, which is usually chosen in the game's graphics settings. ## Files and data - Settings and whitelist are stored in `/data/adb/simple_ram_cleaner` and kept when you update the module. - Uninstalling the module removes that folder. ## Disclaimer This module changes system behavior. Force stopping apps can delay or stop their notifications and alarms until you open them again. Changing the render engine can cause graphical glitches on some ROMs. Use it at your own risk, and keep a way to disable modules (for example Safe Mode) in case something goes wrong. ## License Released under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

Simple Ram and Cache Cleaner

English | Bahasa Indonesia

A simple Magisk / KernelSU module that cleans your RAM and app cache, with a Material Design 3 WebUI, device info, a render engine switcher and an app whitelist.

> Use this module before your gaming session to free up RAM.

Author: MaveYusril

Screenshots


Module in the root manager


RAM usage and device information
Kill Apps, Kill & Force Stop Apps and Clear Apps Cache
Render engine and options

Whitelist
Force stop confirmation
Result after Kill & Force Stop

Result after Clear Apps Cache

Features

  • **Kill Apps**: apps are temporarily stopped, but they can run again later.
  • **Kill & Force Stop Apps**: apps stay stopped until the device restarts or you open them manually.
  • **Clear Apps Cache**: deletes the cache of every app, including whitelisted ones. Accounts and app data are not removed.
  • **Whitelist**: pick the apps that must never be killed or force stopped. A default whitelist (root managers, terminals, WhatsApp, Discord, etc.) is added on first install.
  • **Always protected**: the foreground app, launcher, keyboard, accessibility services, notification listeners and root manager are never touched.
  • **Device information**: device name, chipset (processor name), GPU, RAM, ROM storage capacity, Android version and the current render engine.
  • **Render engine switcher**: Default, Vulkan, OpenGL, SkiaVK, SkiaGL and ANGLE.
  • **Options**: drop page cache after cleaning RAM, and optionally include updated system apps (core system components stay protected).
  • **Action button**: runs a quick *Kill Apps* straight from the module list.
  • **Multi-language WebUI**: English (US, default), Bahasa Indonesia, Chinese, Russian, Hindi and Spanish.

    • Requirements

  • Magisk v20.4 or newer, or a KernelSU-based manager with WebUI support (KernelSU, KernelSU Next, SukiSU, etc.).
  • Root access.

    • Tested on KowSU 35222-5 (manager v3.3.0-101-g9e5e33a2). Other devices and ROMs are not tested yet, so please report what you find.

    Installation

  • Download the latest `.zip` from the [Releases](../../releases) page.
  • Open your root manager, go to **Modules** and install the zip.
  • Reboot if your manager asks you to.
  • Open the module's **WebUI** from the module list.

    • Usage

    | Button | What it does |

    | --- | --- |

    | Kill Apps | Stops background processes of every non-whitelisted app. |

    | Kill & Force Stop Apps | Force stops every non-whitelisted app. Notifications of stopped apps can be delayed. |

    | Clear Cache | Clears the cache of every app, whitelist ignored. |

    | Change Render Engine | Applies the selected render engine. Fully active after a reboot. |

    Add the apps you need (messengers, music players, alarms) to the Whitelist tab before using *Kill & Force Stop*.

    Render engine notes

  • Changes are saved and fully applied after a reboot.
  • **Boot safety:** if the device does not finish booting with a new render engine and you force restart, the module switches back to **Default** on the next boot.
  • **Default** removes the module's settings, so your ROM's own values are used again.
  • ANGLE only works if your ROM ships an ANGLE driver.
  • The render engine only changes how Android draws the system and app UI. Games use their own graphics API, which is usually chosen in the game's graphics settings.

    • Files and data

  • Settings and whitelist are stored in `/data/adb/simple_ram_cleaner` and kept when you update the module.
  • Uninstalling the module removes that folder.

    • Disclaimer

    This module changes system behavior. Force stopping apps can delay or stop their notifications and alarms until you open them again. Changing the render engine can cause graphical glitches on some ROMs. Use it at your own risk, and keep a way to disable modules (for example Safe Mode) in case something goes wrong.

    License

    Released under the MIT License.
